title: Current Tim/Son ↔ Bible Overlap Census — Canonical Router
status: canonical current count and component router
purpose: Provide one stable answer to 'how many documented Bible overlaps are currently in the canonical census?' while preserving additive census history instead of rewriting earlier snapshots.
definition: An overlap node is one analytically distinct project↔Bible relation. It is not one verse, one word match, one fulfilled prophecy or one independent statistical trial.

fresh circuits/perimeters/threshold-motion research; meta-synthesis excluded from count

reference_statistics.method_change: The generator now uses strict full-containment only and never merges merely adjacent citations. The older 105 'compact coverage units' figure is retired because it depended on a less precise compaction heuristic.

historical_78_snapshot.note: 94 is the corrected strict-containment result for the historical 78-node snapshot; regenerate the current 126-node output rather than extrapolating from it.

what_this_number_does_not_mean: 126 does not mean 126 statistically independent coincidences.
126 does not count every Bible verse mentioned anywhere in the repository.
126 does not establish Tim or the Son as a biblical figure by quantity.
126 is the current auditable registry size: the number of comparative relations the project is willing to state in canonical form.
